labels.label: eligible

evidence.quote: Disease must be Stage IV as defined in Section 4.0, or recurrent.
the patient must have received at least one line of a platinum-based chemotherapy regimen or anti-PD-1/PD-L1 therapy
Patients must have Zubrod performance status 0-1

labels.note: Recurrent NSCLC progressing after platinum plus pembrolizumab, PS 0-1; HER2 not an excluded alteration in the screening protocol.

labels.label: excluded

evidence.quote: Neoadjuvant Therapy
Any previous therapy for lung cancer, including chemotherapy, targeted therapy, immunotherapy, or radiotherapy, within 3 years
Previous lung cancer in remission for <3 years

labels.note: Neoadjuvant T-DXd for untreated resectable stage II-IIIB; patient has recurrent disease already treated with chemo-immunotherapy.

labels.label: excluded

evidence.quote: Newly diagnosed early-stage NSCLC
Participants with prior lung cancer
PD-L1 expression in ≥ 1% tumor cells

labels.note: Resectable newly diagnosed NSCLC with listed biomarkers; patient is recurrent, previously treated, PD-L1 0 and HER2-driven.

labels.label: excluded

evidence.quote: PD-L1 expression on ≥1% of tumor cells
Received a platinum-based combination therapy for the treatment of metastatic or recurrent disease

labels.note: Requires PD-L1 >=1%; patient PD-L1 is zero.

labels.label: excluded

evidence.quote: Prior systemic therapy received for advanced or mNSCLC.
anti-programmed cell death protein 1 (PD-1)
Programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) tumour proportion score (TPS) ≥ 1%

labels.note: First-line, PD-L1 positive, IO-naive platform; patient already had chemo-pembrolizumab and PD-L1 is 0.

labels.label: excluded

evidence.quote: Participants must not have other known actionable oncogenic alterations
with a MET exon 14 skipping mutation

labels.note: MET exon 14 substudy excludes known HER2 mutation; patient has HER2 exon 20 insertion.

labels.label: excluded

evidence.quote: Participants must not have other known actionable oncogenic alterations
Participants must have documentation of NSCLC with MET amplification

labels.note: MET amplification substudy excludes known HER2 mutation; patient has HER2 exon 20 insertion.

labels.label: excluded

evidence.quote: Has no known HER2 mutation based on existing test results
Has not been treated with systemic anticancer therapy for advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC.

labels.note: First-line HER2-overexpressing trial; patient has a known HER2 mutation and prior chemo-immunotherapy for recurrence.
